title: AS2 compiler: global setProperty()/getProperty() fall through to ActionCallFunction — should emit ActionSetProperty (0x23)/ActionGetProperty (0x22)
description:
In AS2 timeline scripts, setProperty(target, property, value) and getProperty(target, property) are valid global functions that must emit ActionSetProperty (0x23) and ActionGetProperty (0x22) opcodes respectively.

Current behaviour: both fall through to generic ActionCallFunction('setProperty') / ActionCallFunction('getProperty'). Ruffle's AVM1 globals (globals.rs create_globals) do NOT register setProperty or getProperty as global function objects — only as MovieClip methods. ActionCallFunction will thus produce undefined at runtime.

ActionSetProperty (0x23) stack protocol per Ruffle activation.rs action_set_property():
  pops: property_index (UI16-equivalent), target path (string), value
  push order: value (deepest), target (middle), property_index (top)

ActionGetProperty (0x22) stack protocol:
  pops: property_index, target path
  push order: target (deepest), property_index (top)

Property indices for the SWF 'legacy property' table (per SWF spec / Ruffle):
  _x=0, _y=1, _xscale=2, _yscale=3, _currentframe=4, _totalframes=5, _alpha=6, _visible=7,
  _width=8, _height=9, _rotation=10, _target=11, _framesloaded=12, _name=13, _droptarget=14,
  _url=15, _highquality=16, _focusrect=17, _soundbuftime=18, _quality=19, _xmouse=20, _ymouse=21

Fix in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts compileCallExpr():
1. Add 'setProperty', 'getProperty' to the string-pool exclusion list.
2. Add built-in handlers:
   - setProperty(target, propIndex, value): push value, push target, push propIndex, emit 0x23
   - getProperty(target, propIndex): push target, push propIndex, emit 0x22
3. Add tests.

References: ruffle/swf/src/avm1/opcode.rs (SetProperty=0x23, GetProperty=0x22), ruffle/core/src/avm1/activation.rs.
